entities.summary: Guido Jung was a performers & entertainers in Palermo (1876-02-02, Palermo – 1949-12-25) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
